verdict.rationale: Cake explicitly offers 'bulk upload tools' for migrating spreadsheet cap tables (docs-17) and a managed migration/data-matching process for Carta/Pulley imports (docs-2, docs-15, docs-37, docs-38), showing batch ingestion of historical transactions is supported. However, evidence is centered on one-time migration workflows rather than an ops user self-service bulk grant issuance tool for ongoing operations, and no UI/API details (e.g., CSV template for new grants, bulk-issue button) are shown. Missing for 10: documented self-serve bulk grant issuance interface (not just migration), evidence of batch API/CSV upload for day-to-day new transactions, and independent confirmation of ease/scale.
